description: The five commands the window may call, the engine event channel, the window controls it draws itself, and a folder picker. No shell, no network, no filesystem access. The one path the window can read is the session's previews/ subdirectory, granted at runtime once the engine names it: those are derived thumbnails, and the recovered artifacts themselves stay unreachable from the web view. The static scope is empty on purpose, so nothing is readable before a scan grants it.
